/narrative.1: The overall development goal of KCEP-CRAL is to contribute to the reduction of rural poverty and food insecurity of smallholders in the ASALs by developing their economic potential while improving their natural resources management capacity and resilience to climate change in an increasingly fragile ecosystem.  This development goal will be pursued through two specific objectives:  (i) the graduation of smallholders farmers to commercially-oriented, climate resilient agricultural practices through improvements in productivity, post-production management practices and market linkages for targeted value chains; and (ii) the empowerment of country governments and communities to sustainably and sonsensually manage their natural resources and to build their resilience to climate change.
